items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Verlon Page, who played the tuba, Big Page come in his place, you understand?

ctx.x: I think so. But I know I named the ones that I remember was there. Just like I say, Page and Buster Smith, Lips Page, Dan Miner, and I've forgotten now, we had some boy singing there, too.
And the drummer was Alvin Burrows?
